title: usagePreviewStyle
responsibility: The inline style that places a usage preview beside its link within its owning card, or null once the link is off screen.

inputs.name: usagePreviewStyle.root
inputs.description: The element holding the usage link.

inputs.name: usagePreviewStyle.tip
inputs.description: The preview element; its width is set while measuring.

inputs.name: usagePreviewStyle.view
inputs.description: The width and height of the screen.

outputs.name: usagePreviewStyle
outputs.description: The inline left, top, width and optional max-height style; null when the link is off screen.
